Description: Hold That Thought - Consolidated API with Single-Table DynamoDB

GoogleClientId.Description: Google OAuth Client ID (leave empty to skip Google OAuth setup)

RagStackGraphQLApiUrl.Description: RAGStack GraphQL API URL (required for existing stack, auto-populated for new)

ArchiveBucket.Description: S3 bucket for letters, media, and profile photos (single bucket architecture)

RagStackStackName.Description: Name of an existing RAGStack stack (informational only). Leave empty to deploy a new nested RAGStack stack.

SesFromEmail.Description: Email address to send notifications from (domain must be verified in SES)

AppDomain.Description: App domain for OAuth callbacks (e.g., localhost:5173 for dev, holdthatthought.family for prod)

RagStackChatWidgetUrl.Description: RAGStack Chat Widget CDN URL (required for existing stack, auto-populated for new)

RagStackGraphQLApiKey.Description: RAGStack GraphQL API Key (required for existing stack, auto-populated for new)

RagStackAdminEmail.Description: Admin email for RAGStack (only required for new deployments)

RagStackTemplateUrl.Description: S3 URL of the packaged RAGStack CloudFormation template (only used for new deployments)

RagStackDataBucketName.Description: RAGStack data S3 bucket name (required for existing stack, auto-populated for new)

AdminEmail.Description: Admin email address for contact form submissions

Properties.Description: Notification processor - send emails from DynamoDB streams
Activity aggregator - update user stats from DynamoDB streams
Letter processor - merges PDFs and parses with Gemini
Consolidated API - comments, messages, profiles, reactions, media
